definition: Percentage of total student population that secured a placement outcome.
interpretation: Proportion of students placed in cohort.
limitations: Does not reflect job quality or retention.

definition: Total physical count of placed students.
limitations: Raw count only; depends on cohort size.

definition: Total physical count of unplaced students.
Total count of technical skills possessed by an individual student (range 0 to 7).
formula: SUM(python + sql + excel + power_bi + dsa + cloud + cybersecurity)
limitations: Treats all 7 skills as equal weight.

definition: Percentage of total students possessing a specific technical skill.
interpretation: Adoption/penetration rate of skill in cohort.
limitations: Does not measure depth of expertise.

definition: Placement rate among students possessing a specific technical skill.
interpretation: Placement success rate for skill holders.

definition: Percentage point difference in placement rate between students with vs without a skill.
interpretation: Observed placement rate premium associated with skill.
limitations: Confounded by co-occurring skills and scores.

definition: Middle value of compensation package (LPA) among placed students.
interpretation: Typical salary package achieved by placed cohort.
limitations: Conditional on placement; unavailable for unplaced.

definition: Arithmetic average compensation package (LPA) among placed students.
interpretation: Average package achieved by placed cohort.
limitations: Sensitive to extreme high/low package outliers.

definition: Placement rate calculated within a specific academic branch.
limitations: Influenced by branch size and student preferences.

definition: Difference in mean or median performance scores between placed and unplaced students.
interpretation: Observed score gap between placed and unplaced cohorts.

definition: Difference in median package between comparative segments (e.g. branches or company types).
interpretation: Compensation gap between employer or academic segments.

definition: Placement rate within a defined CGPA performance band.
limitations: Band boundary selection can alter visuals.

definition: Placement rate within a defined coding score performance band.
